announced on Tuesday that it plans to redeem $1B of its outstanding 6.900% Senior Secured Notes due 2027.
The redemption is scheduled for October 2, 2026, subject to securing enough financing to cover the repayment and related costs.
Moreover, the company is exploring a new senior secured notes offering to fund the redemptions, including the redemption price, accrued interest, premiums, and related costs tied to the 2027 Notes.

If the financing condition is met or waived, the company may use cash on hand to fund part of the redemption, while any remaining proceeds could be used for general corporate purposes or other debt repayment.
Once redeemed, the 2027 Notes will be cancelled, and no further interest will accrue after the redemption date.
On the market side, the Open Text shares traded ~1.52% higher at ~$23.43 in the pre-market trading.

title: OpenText sets $1B debt redemption, eyes new notes offering
